data.content: Implementation review approved against origin/main 2b028bf17ba6 and acceptance criteria. Push loads and validates the active generation before scanning; generation-two and legacy refs are isolated; staging and activation use force-with-lease CAS; pruning removes only exact cutoff blobs outside the retained delta while preserving absent/unpushed paths and rejecting conflicts. Real Git tests cover competing publishers, legacy isolation, retained and unpushed paths, conflict safety, and idempotence. Diff is clean; lint and three full sanity/pre-push runs passed at 95.11-95.12% coverage. No snapshot schema overlap with knots-2af8.
